facts.statement: THR at address 0 width 8 access W is Transmit FIFO input
facts.quote:
Transmitter Holding
Register (THR)
0 8 W Transmit FIFO input

facts.statement: Divisor latches accessed when LCR DLAB bit 7 is 1 while addresses 0-1 normal registers cannot be accessed
facts.quote:
The registers can be accessed when the 7th (DLAB) bit of the Line Control Register is set
to ‘1’. At this time the above registers at addresses 0-1 can’t be accessed.

facts.statement: Core implements WISHBONE SoC bus interface with 8-bit data bus as responder
facts.quote:
The core implements the WISNBONE SoC bus interface for communication with the
system. It has an 8-bit data bus for compatibility reason.

facts.statement: STX_PAD_O is serial output and SRX_PAD_I is serial input
facts.quote:
STX_PAD_O 1 Output The serial output signal
SRX_PAD_I 1 Input The serial input signal

facts.statement: UART core provides serial communication with modem or external devices
facts.quote:
The UART (Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter) core provides serial
communication capabilities
